messages.subject: preventing bin from stretching across multiple bar widths
parts:
Dear list,

imagine if you will, the first image in position_dodge help page. 8 cylinder variable has only one level and its corresponding column also take up space of the "neighbor" that is not there (and is in effect wider than the rest). Is there a way to limit bars that have no "neighbors" (like 4 and 6 do) to not stretch over two bar widths?

Cheers,
Roman

messages.subject: Re: preventing bin from stretching across multiple bar widths
parts:
Romunov

You can find the answer, and a discussion of the relative merits of
faceting vs. dodging, on page 125 of the ggplot book.

The trick is to make use of faceting in addition to dodging.

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=factor(vs), fill=factor(vs))) +
geom_bar(position="dodge") + facet_grid(.~cyl)

Andrie
